name: profiles_vs_message_filters
title: Read vs read by type: whole Person rows vs one column of many messages
expect: Person Condensed props, Message Split (or Chunked) props
why: point7 wants Person properties Condensed; the date filter wants Message properties Split (bytes) or Chunked (ops). A mixed layout can give each its own, but point7 is so cheap ({p7_ops} ops in all) that it barely moves the total ({saving} fewer ops).
